messages:
Ava (Marketing): quick sync  draft of the product launch post uploaded: https://docs.google.com/draft (comments open). Need fast passes today on hero claim, benchmark framing, CTAs, and inbound routing for webinar signups. target: lock by Eod.

Priya (Product): skimmed & left inline notes. the '2x latency' bullet needs either a source or softer phrasing. Also add a short customer quote placeholder.

Elliot (Design): hero comps look fine; i'll export 2 crop variants + thumbs. need final alt text from copy so images are accessible.

Sam (Growth): adding hubspot UTMs now. header CTA should go to webinar + blog. sample utm: `utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=mar2026_product`. Recommend adding webinar RSVP above the fold as lead magnet.

Ben (Sales Ops): inbound routing q: what qualifying fields? i'll map Enterprise -> AE queue, Mid-market -> SDR by default. ping me with exact lead tag values before publish.

Priya (Product): tagging @Tom (CTO) for a 1-2 line technical quote about latency/cost. Tom, can you drop something short for hero?

Tom (CTO): Draft quote: "Redwood Inference reduces tail latency while lowering per-token inference cost, letting teams ship responsive LLM features without rearchitecting their stack." happy to shorten.

LegalBot: automated scan: flagged phrase 'industry-leading 99% uptime' as unverified 12 please supply substantiation or reword.

Ava (Marketing): thanks 12 softened to 'SLA-backed uptime targets' and linked infra page. removed hard 99% stat. moved Tom's quote into hero variants.

Sam (Growth): live UTM snippets added. webinar CTA: header -> /register?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=mar2026_webinar. added secondary CTA for demo requests.

Ben (Sales Ops): confirmed routing mapping in ops doc: Enterprise -> AE-Live; Mid-Market -> Inbound SDR; Demo requests -> DemoOps queue. tags set: `lead_tier:enterprise|midmarket|demo`.

Elliot (Design): uploaded hero_variantA.jpg & hero_variantB.jpg to assets; left alt text suggestions in doc.

Ava (Marketing): locking content at 17:30 PT. will hand to publishing to schedule. final nits now or hold until post-publish.

LaunchBot: publish window reserved for 2026-03-12 13:00 UTC.

Sam (Growth): approved from growth side :thumbsup: tiny wording tweak for the RSVP button: 'Reserve your spot' -> 'Save my seat'.

Ben (Sales Ops): routing rules deployed to staging. i'll watch first-hour leads and report any mismatches.

Ava (Marketing): checklist: legal ok (resolved), CTO quote in hero, images uploaded, UTMs and routing mapped. pushing to staging now.

LaunchBot: deploy scheduled: blog-staging -> production at 2026-03-12T13:00:00Z.

Ava (Marketing): copy pushed to staging. reconvene post-publish for performance & lead flow readout.
